questions.question: It's Paul Ince's birthday today, 21st Oct 2026; which Italian club did Ince sign for after leaving Manchester United?

questions.question: Ashley Young was handed which squad number at Aston Villa from 2007–2011?

questions.question: How many Premier League titles has Jamie Carragher won?
questions.explanation: Despite never winning the league, Jamie Carragher won the Champions League, FA Cup, and League Cup with Liverpool. Carragher made 737 total appearances for Liverpool, placing him second on the club's all-time appearance list.

questions.question: How many Premier League appearances did Alan Shearer make?
questions.explanation: Alan Shearer is the all-time top goalscorer in Premier League history with 260 goals. He won his only Premier League title as a player with Blackburn Rovers in the 1994–95 season.
